paragraphs.text: For centuries, mapmakers copied details from earlier maps rather than visiting the places themselves. As a result, mistakes could survive for hundreds of years. One of the best known is the belief that California was an island, which appeared on European maps from the early 1600s.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The error probably began with a single account of a sea voyage and spread because printed maps were copied widely. Even after explorers travelled overland from Mexico to California in the late 1600s, many publishers continued to show the island, partly because engraving a new copper plate was expensive.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Mistakes did not only affect coastlines. Some maps showed mountain ranges that did not exist. One of these, the Mountains of Kong in West Africa, remained on maps for about a century before a French expedition in the 1880s reported that there were no mountains there.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Today’s digital maps are updated far more often, but they are not free from error. In 2012 researchers noticed a small island in the Pacific that appeared on several online maps but had never been seen by ships passing the area. It was removed after a survey vessel sailed through the empty sea where it was supposed to be.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: mapmakers copied details from earlier maps rather than visiting the places themselves
items.prompt: Mapmakers in the past often relied on earlier maps instead of their own travels.

explanation.en: “copied details from earlier maps rather than visiting the places themselves” — the statement says the same thing → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «copied details from earlier maps rather than visiting the places themselves» — «relied on earlier maps instead of their own travels» дәл осыны айтады → TRUE.
explanation.ru: «copied details from earlier maps rather than visiting the places themselves» — «relied on earlier maps instead of their own travels» говорит то же самое → TRUE.

items.quote: which appeared on European maps from the early 1600s
items.prompt: The idea that California was an island first appeared on Spanish maps.

explanation.en: The text says “European maps” without saying whose. Spanish maps are European too, so there is no contradiction, but no confirmation either → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Мәтінде «European maps» деп қана айтылған, қай елдікі екені нақтыланбаған. Испан карталары да еуропалық, сондықтан қайшылық жоқ, бірақ растау да жоқ → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: В тексте «European maps» — чьи именно, не уточняется. Испанские карты тоже европейские, поэтому противоречия нет, но и подтверждения нет → NOT GIVEN.

items.quote: many publishers continued to show the island
items.prompt: Publishers stopped showing California as an island as soon as the overland journey had been made.

explanation.en: “Even after explorers travelled overland … many publishers continued to show the island” — they did not stop at once → FALSE.
explanation.kk: «Even after explorers travelled overland … many publishers continued to show the island» — аралды бірден алып тастамай, сала берген → FALSE.
explanation.ru: «Even after explorers travelled overland … many publishers continued to show the island» — продолжали рисовать остров, а не перестали сразу → FALSE.

items.quote: remained on maps for about a century
items.prompt: The Mountains of Kong were shown on maps for around one hundred years.

explanation.en: “remained on maps for about a century” — the Mountains of Kong stayed on maps for roughly a hundred years. “Around one hundred years” is the same period in other words → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «remained on maps for about a century» — Конг таулары карталарда жүз жылдай тұрған. «Around one hundred years» — сол мерзімнің басқаша айтылуы → TRUE.
explanation.ru: «remained on maps for about a century» — горы Конг держались на картах около ста лет. «Around one hundred years» — тот же срок другими словами → TRUE.

items.quote: had never been seen by ships passing the area
items.prompt: Several ships had reported the Pacific island before 2012.

explanation.en: “had never been seen by ships passing the area” — ships never saw it, so they could not report it. “Several online maps” is a distractor: maps, not ships → FALSE.
explanation.kk: «had never been seen by ships passing the area» — кемелер аралды ешқашан көрмеген, демек ол туралы хабарлай алмаған. «Several online maps» — кемелер емес, карталар, алаңдатушы дерек → FALSE.
explanation.ru: «had never been seen by ships passing the area» — корабли его никогда не видели, значит, и сообщить о нём не могли. «Several online maps» — дистрактор, это карты, а не корабли → FALSE.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage? Write TRUE if the statement agrees with the information, FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, or NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.
